name: Supermarket Income REIT Plc
source: Supermarket Income REIT plc audited consolidated statement of comprehensive income, year ended 30 June 2026 (Annual Report 2026, Grant Thornton unqualified opinion); figures in GBP, statements printed in thousands, amounts here are the full amounts. Revenue is gross rental income 101,143 plus service charge income 10,071; Cost of Sales is the matching service charge expense 10,726 (stored positive, the direction the column's own Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit identity requires); Gross Profit is net rental income 100,488; Operating Expenses is administrative and other expenses 10,698; Operating Profit (EBIT) is the statement's own Operating profit line 117,972; Net Finance Costs is finance income 7,343 less finance expense 40,618, the same basis as the FY2025 column; Profit Before Tax 84,489; the tax credit for the year 1,437 is stored negative, as in FY2025, so Profit Before Tax less Income Tax gives Profit for the year 85,926; EPS is basic and diluted 6.9 pence per share. Balance sheet items used for ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are total assets 1,877,630, total liabilities 764,983 and net assets 1,112,647 at 30 June 2026.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT); the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

note: The company reports in pounds sterling and the statements print thousands; figures here are the full amounts. The JSE line is a secondary listing quoted in rand. Revenue is gross rental income plus service charge income and cost of sales is the matching service charge expense, so the printed net rental income is the gross profit. Operating profit is the printed line, which includes the investment property revaluation, a termination fee and the share of joint income from the joint venture. Earnings per share is printed as 4.9 pence (2024: a loss of 1.7 pence) and is shown here in pounds. The profit before tax also absorbs a fair value movement of 18,842,000 on interest rate derivatives, which has no panel row.
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
